pages.text: It swings a 3-hit blade combo and leaps at you. Hit it 3 times quickly and it $(thing)guards$(): it parries hits from the front and strikes back, so back off or get behind it.
pages.title: Apex Mantis

pages.text: When angry it vanishes into camouflage. Listen for rustling and chimes: a loud chime comes half a second before it strikes. Hitting it reveals it.
A $(item)Mantis Eye$() and the $(item)Mantis Greatclaw$(), always. The Greatclaw is a weak blade on purpose: it's the base of the $(l:gear/weapons)Serrated Longsword$(/l).
pages.title: Drops
